newsitem.title: USA: USDA buys 1.44 mln lbs frozen hams for schools.
newsitem.headline: USDA buys 1.44 mln lbs frozen hams for schools.

text.p: The Agricultural Marketing Service of the U.S. Department of Agriculture said it bought 1,440,000 pounds of frozen smoked fully cooked hams for use in the National School Lunch Program.

AMS said it bought the hams at awarded prices ranging from $1.6715-$1.9299 per pound in the first purchase of hams since the program was announced on August 19. Shipments are to be between October 5 and 18, 1996.

Winning bidders were Clougherty Packing Co (Los Angeles, Calif.) 108,000 lbs, Farmland Foods Inc (Albert Lea, Minn.) 900,000 lbs, and John Morrell and Co (Great Bend, Kan., and Sioux Falls, S.S.) 432,000 lbs.
